The tiers

One tier every 100 XP. Claim a tier when you reach it; anything left unclaimed when the season ends is granted automatically, so a missed click never costs a reward.
Season XP counts everything you earn from the season start: closes, green closes, check-ins, Academy lessons, missions, duels, goals. Pass rewards themselves pay Ticks, never XP, so the ladder cannot feed itself.

How it works

Free for everyoneEvery member has the free track. Reach a tier, claim its Ticks. Tier 20 also unlocks the Arctic frame.
Pro trackDoubles the Ticks on all 20 tiers and adds four Vault items at tiers 5, 10, 15 and 20, ending on a legendary frame.
Fourteen daysSeasons follow the leaderboards: same start, same end, 00:00 UTC. A new pass opens with each season.
Nothing is lostReached tiers you did not click are granted when the season closes. Ticks land in your wallet; items in your Vault.
